signature.composition: large blue broken ring left with orange tag outside lower right

prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on pure white for releasing a locked PLC tag. Draw a LARGE BLUE CIRCULAR ENCLOSURE with an exceptionally wide OPEN GAP at LOWER RIGHT, like a big C rotated toward the gap. An ORANGE TAG with a large white hole is positioned OUTSIDE the circle just beyond that gap. A thick BLACK ARROW points from the inside of the ring diagonally outward through the gap toward the tag. The open ring must dominate and the gap and arrow must be obvious at 30x18. No padlock, shield, hand, door, chain, key, text or shadows. All art fits within central 70 percent of square.
